label: Codex approval review: disposable DB recovery + bulk-run preflight diagnostics on Windows VM
summary: Continued approving a run of read-only Codex diagnostic actions (process list, SQL request/blocker inspection via prlctl, log tail, lsof) while debugging a stalled bulk-run preflight against the disposable Windows 11 VM; all approved as low-risk read-only checks. Also approved an apply_patch adding a chunked, SHA-256-verified file transfer mechanism to the bulk snapshot create-and-verify script, working around Parallels rejecting long encoded PowerShell command lines.
